name: Satsujin Roman Kikou - Koi no Nagano Bojou
original_name: 殺人ロマン紀行 恋の長野慕情
source:
Heroine works for top brand fashion company. One day the president of the company disappears. As the business starts to crumble hero with three friends go Nagano ski resort to cheer up. By coincidence this place is close to president's hometown and they get caught up in a series of murder cases involving the disappearance of the president.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-october-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角任职于一家顶级时装品牌企业。一天，公司总裁突然失踪，企业经营也开始分崩离析。为了排解烦闷，她与三名朋友前往长野的滑雪胜地。巧合的是，这里离总裁的故乡很近，几人也因此卷入一连串与总裁失踪有关的谋杀案。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-october-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
